# Nuclo

> Nuclo is a lightweight, zero-dependency, type-safe DOM library for JavaScript and TypeScript. You build the UI with global tag-builder functions such as `div()` and `button()`, keep state in plain mutable variables, and call `update()` to sync the real DOM. There is no virtual DOM, no compiler, no proxies, no signals and no automatic change tracking. It ships server-side rendering with hydration and a typed atomic CSS-in-TS engine. MIT licensed.

Nuclo is not React, Vue, Solid or Svelte. There are no hooks, no JSX, no components API, no reactive primitives and no effects. A component is a plain function that returns a builder. Nothing on the page changes until code calls `update()`.

## Core rules

- Install with `npm install nuclo`, or scaffold a Vite + TypeScript app with `npm create nuclo@latest`.
- `import 'nuclo'` once, before any code that calls a builder. It registers globals: 175 tag builders (`div`, `span`, ..., `var_` for `<var>`; SVG tags use an `Svg` suffix: `svgSvg`, `pathSvg`, `circleSvg`) and 14 helpers: `update`, `scope`, `when`, `list`, `on`, `render`, `hydrate`, `forceUpdate`, `css`, `cx`, `createCss`, `variants`, `keyframes`, `globalStyle`.
- Tag builders are globals only: `import { div } from 'nuclo'` does not work. Helpers are also named exports.
- A function with zero parameters is a dynamic value, re-run on every `update()`: ``p(() => `Hi ${name}`)``, `{ disabled: () => busy }`. A function that declares a parameter is a modifier that receives the element and runs once.
- Mutate state directly (`count++`, `todos.push(t)`), then call `update()` once. `update('id')` only updates elements marked with `scope('id')`.
- Conditionals: `when(() => cond, ...children).when(...).else(...)`. Never `cond && el`: booleans render as the text "false".
- Lists: `list(() => items, (item, index) => li(...))`. Rows are matched by object identity and kept rows are not rendered again, so use dynamic values for fields that change.
- Events: `{ onClick: (e) => ... }` in an attribute object, or `on('click', fn, options)` for several listeners, listener options or custom events.
- Lifecycle: `{ onMount: (el) => cleanup?, onDestroy: (el) => ... }`. Hooks run once per element and are not effects.
- Classes: use `className` (or a `css()` result), not `class`. Inline `style` takes a camelCase object with explicit units.
- Mount with `render(App, root)`: pass the component, not `App()`. Render into an element that is in the document; detached nodes stop updating.
- SSR: `import 'nuclo/polyfill'` then `import 'nuclo'` on the server, call `renderToString(App)` and put `getCssText()` in `<style id="nuclo-styles">`. On the client call `hydrate(App, root)`. Do not strip HTML comments from server output.
- TypeScript: set `"moduleResolution": "bundler"`.

```ts
import 'nuclo'

let count = 0

const App = () =>
  div(
    h1(() => `Count: ${count}`),
    button('Add one', { onClick: () => { count++; update() } }),
  )

render(App, document.getElementById('app')!)
```

## Docs

- [Full documentation as Markdown](https://nuclo.dev/llms-full.txt): every docs section plus all examples in one file. Prefer this for complete context.
- [Overview](https://nuclo.dev/docs#overview): what Nuclo is and the mental model
- [Quick Start](https://nuclo.dev/docs#quick-start): scaffold a project with create-nuclo
- [Installation & Imports](https://nuclo.dev/docs#installation): globals, named exports and entry points (`nuclo`, `nuclo/ssr`, `nuclo/polyfill`, `nuclo/types`)
- [TypeScript](https://nuclo.dev/docs#typescript-setup): tsconfig setup and global types such as `NodeModFn` and `NodeModLike`
- [Tag Builders](https://nuclo.dev/docs#tag-builders): builder arguments, custom modifiers, SVG and the full list of builders
- [Components](https://nuclo.dev/docs#components): plain functions, per-instance state and children
- [Attributes](https://nuclo.dev/docs#attributes): properties vs attributes, `className` merging and inline styles
- [Events](https://nuclo.dev/docs#events): `on*` attributes and the `on()` modifier
- [Lifecycle](https://nuclo.dev/docs#lifecycle): `onMount`, `onDestroy`, cleanups and unmounting
- [Explicit Updates](https://nuclo.dev/docs#explicit-updates): why and when to call `update()`
- [Dynamic Values](https://nuclo.dev/docs#dynamic-functions): how zero-parameter functions become live text and attributes

## API reference

- [update()](https://nuclo.dev/docs#api-update): run every dynamic value, or only those inside given scopes
- [scope()](https://nuclo.dev/docs#api-scope): mark an element as a named update root
- [when()](https://nuclo.dev/docs#api-when): conditional content with `.when()` and `.else()` chains
- [list()](https://nuclo.dev/docs#api-list): render one row per item, matched by identity
- [forceUpdate()](https://nuclo.dev/docs#api-force-update): re-run components to refresh static values, such as a language switch
- [render()](https://nuclo.dev/docs#api-render): build a tree and append it to the DOM
- [hydrate()](https://nuclo.dev/docs#api-hydrate): take over server-rendered HTML
- [Server Rendering](https://nuclo.dev/docs#api-ssr): `renderToString`, `renderManyToString`, `renderToStringWithContainer` from `nuclo/ssr`
- [nuclo/polyfill](https://nuclo.dev/docs#api-polyfill): the minimal DOM for Node, Bun and Deno
- [css()](https://nuclo.dev/docs#api-styling): typed style objects compiled to atomic classes
- [Style Objects](https://nuclo.dev/docs#style-objects): shorthands, pseudo states, `&` selectors, `@` rules and `raw`
- [cx()](https://nuclo.dev/docs#api-cx): compose styles with last-wins conflict resolution
- [createCss()](https://nuclo.dev/docs#api-create-css): themed styling with colors, fonts, radii, shadows and screens
- [variants()](https://nuclo.dev/docs#api-variants): typed style recipes with default and compound variants
- [keyframes() & globalStyle()](https://nuclo.dev/docs#api-keyframes): animations and global rules
- [getCssText() & resetStyles()](https://nuclo.dev/docs#api-css-text): collect CSS for SSR, reset styles in tests
- [API Index](https://nuclo.dev/docs#api-index): every public function and where it is exported from

## Guides

- [Computed Values](https://nuclo.dev/docs#computed): derived state with plain functions
- [Async & Loading](https://nuclo.dev/docs#async): fetch with loading and error states
- [Best Practices](https://nuclo.dev/docs#best-practices): batching, scopes, styles and SSR checklist
- [FAQ](https://nuclo.dev/docs#faq): common pitfalls such as text showing "false" or parts of the UI not updating
- [Examples](https://nuclo.dev/examples): live counter, todo list, search filter and styling demos with source
